 Chitwan Rhinos choose to bat against Sudurpaschim Royals in NPL qualifier 
 Nepal News 
 November 19, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Chitwan Rhinos have decided to bat first against Sudurpaschim Royals in the second qualifier match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL). The match is being held at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, with play scheduled to begin at 5 p.m.
 Sudurpaschim Royals entered the second qualifier after losing to Lumbini Lions in the first qualifier. Chitwan Rhinos secured their spot in this match following a 61-run victory over Kathmandu Gorkhas in the eliminator round on Wednesday. The winner of today’s match will face Lumbini Lions in the tournament final.
 In the history of the NPL, the two teams have faced each other three times, with Sudurpaschim winning two matches and Chitwan winning one. During the league stage of the current season, Sudurpaschim defeated Chitwan by five wickets.
 For Chitwan Rhinos, Ravi Bopara has scored 237 runs in six matches, while Rizan Dhakal leads their bowling attack with 16 wickets. For Sudurpaschim Royals, captain Dipendra Singh Airee has scored 202 runs in eight matches, and Anil Kharel has claimed 10 wickets.
